_doc: Editions whose target words eflomal aligns as PARTS (prefixes, stem, suffixes), from a part analysis pinned here by dataset, tag and sha256 (lexeme_aligner/target_parts.py; run_pilot consults this file per edition tag unless --target-parts is given). Measured 2026-10-23 on heb_scg vs Nestle 1904, eflomal step, 3 runs each (pipeline/work/parts-ab): function words linked 55.9% -> 82.0%, class-compatible function links 57.5% -> 76.4%, content words linked 94.3% -> 95.5%, links stable over runs 79.5% -> 83.8%; hand check function links ~19/30 -> ~24/30, content disagreements won 14 vs 6. Letters beat lemma+class (no gain, less stable).

kvg_wbt._doc: 2026-10-28: Kuni by parts, LOCAL ONLY (owner: run bsb-add-books' segmenter; option A = publish part numbers + this pin). chain: false = the production chain keeps aligning kvg_wbt by whole words; pipeline/work/kvg-parts/run.sh runs the parts route by hand. The split file holds the CC BY-NC-ND text and is never published; only `segmenter` + `numbering` go into the compact manifest (target_parts.parts_pin).
kvg_wbt.numbering: bcv_segment.load(module).S.split(word, tones=True) on the WRITTEN token (bcv-commons/bibles verse-text tokenize_written, same position as the tokenizer's token); part = index in that list (prefixes, stem, tone, suffixes). A token whose split does not rebuild the written word is linked whole.
